body: True adjoint release yields the stronger original-waveform return. Relative root error itself requires only a common release; avoid adding unnecessary adjoint hardware to that weaker task. A fixed one-photon common phase is number dependent across Fock sectors. Unreversed diagonal drift and permanent bath coupling are not cancelled by conjugating controllable hopping. The original equation remains preserved with this current scope clarification.
